subject: Add mean standard errors for groups

messages.author: 88f291eb04da4f6e
messages.subject: Add mean standard errors for groups
parts:
Hello! 

So I have a plot, and I want to add the mean standard errors for the different groups, because adding error bars to each point is quite cluttered. Using the "Random.csv" data attached the plot is: 

library(ggplot2)

r <- read.csv("Random.csv", header = T)

p1 <- qplot(TREAT, RAND, data = r, stat="summary", fun.y = "mean" , group=MALE, width=1.5,) 

 Then I calculate the mean standard errors:  

library (doBy)

library (sciplot)

r1 = summaryBy ( RAND ~ MALE * TREATMENT, data = r, FUN = c ( se ))

r2 = summaryBy (RAND.se ~ TREATMENT , data = r1 , FUN = c(mean))

So the "r2" data set has the SE's that I want to plot around arbitrary points on the graph.

I've attached the resulting plot, with MSPaint error bars how I would like, in the example the error bars (mean standard errors in "r2") for each treatment are at 57.5 plus or minus the SE.   

Sorry for the horrible MSPaint example, but thanks in advance for any help on adding these to my plots. 

Cheers, 

Ackley

messages.author: 87cf4991b6a810ee
messages.subject: Re: Add mean standard errors for groups
parts:
Checkout http://www.cookbook-r.com/Graphs/Plotting_means_and_error_bars_(ggplot2)/

On this page is a really handy function: summarySE()

r.se <- summarySE(r,measurevar="RAND",groupvars=c("TREAT"))
ggplot(r.se, aes(x=TREAT,y=RAND)) + geom_point() + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=RAND-se,ymax=RAND+se))
